subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should macOS gateway LaunchAgent generation support Volta shim fallback when no supported system Node is available?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes the supported managed-service runtime policy for version-manager Node paths that current audit and docs intentionally warn about.

options.title: Accept Volta Shim With Proof
options.body: Review a refreshed Volta-specific implementation only after it adds focused resolver/runtime tests and redacted live macOS LaunchAgent install or restart proof.

options.title: Reject Shim Fallback
options.body: Keep system/Homebrew Node as the supported service runtime and close this direction after improving doctor/setup guidance for Volta users.

options.title: Fold Into Runtime Pinning
options.body: Resolve this through a broader maintainer-sponsored exact runtime path contract instead of adding a Volta-only fallback rule.

recommendation.title: Accept Volta Shim With Proof
recommendation.body: Review a refreshed Volta-specific implementation only after it adds focused resolver/runtime tests and redacted live macOS LaunchAgent install or restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the current runtime selection implementation and the prior Homebrew stable-node merge, and can decide whether this version-manager fallback belongs in core.
